Should not exceed 62 years as on the last date for submission of Application

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must fulfill the essential educational qualification and experience requirements to be eligible for the University Librarian position. Essential Educational Qualification: Master’s Degree in Library Science/Information Science from a recognized University/Educational Institution. Essential Experience: Retired Librarians from National level Educational Institutions/State Universities with a minimum of 5 years’ experience as Deputy librarian and/or above. Age Limit: Should not exceed 62 years as on the last date for submission of application. Age relaxation is not eligible.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The position carries a consolidated remuneration ranging from Rs. 60,000/- to 80,000/- per month, determined based on experience. The appointment is initially for a period of one year on a contract basis, which is extendable based on performance and requirements.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DUK University Librarian
content_sections.text: Visit the official recruitment portal at https://www.duk.ac.in/careers. Fill out the online application form with the required details. Upload scanned copies of documents to prove age, qualifications, and experience. Submit the application online latest by 15.10.2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection process will be based on a test and/or interview. The test or interview will be conducted in Thiruvananthapuram district only. Candidates will be informed of the schedule through their registered email.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DUK University Librarian Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 15.10.2026.

faq.question: Q2. Is the appointment permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The appointment is initially for one year on a contract basis, and it is extendable based on performance and requirements.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates should not exceed 62 years of age as on the last date for submission of application, and age relaxation is not applicable.

faq.question: Q4. Can retired librarians apply for this post?
faq.answer: Yes, retired librarians from National level Educational Institutions or State Universities with a minimum of 5 years of experience as Deputy Librarian and/or above are eligible to apply.
